facts.fact: The World Bank's Digital Economy Diagnostic states that Guinea-Bissau does not possess a government-wide digital transformation strategy with a whole-of-government vision and programme, and recommends developing a countrywide one; the document is dated 2022 only and is dated here by its published year.
